details: Bitcoin's price tested $81,250 on May 6, 2026, reaching its highest level since late January. This rally is primarily driven by $2.44 billion in April spot ETF inflows, easing U.S.-Iran tensions, and the absorption of MicroStrategy's signaled possible BTC sales. The price increase comes after breaking multi-month resistance.
title: Bitcoin Surges Above $81K Amid ETF Inflows & Geopolitical Relief

details: Ethereum (ETH) is holding steady above $2,300, even as retail investors have been net distributors, offloading around 1.5 million ETH over the past two weeks. Conversely, large whale wallets have accumulated approximately 230,000 ETH, indicating sustained institutional confidence. Derivatives show mixed sentiment with negative funding rates but a bullish technical outlook.
title: Ethereum Holds $2,300 Despite Retail Distribution, Whales Accumulate

details: Zcash (ZEC) has surged over 42% in the last 24 hours to nearly $600, reaching its highest level since November 2025. This significant rally is attributed to strong buying pressure from major funds, a tightening supply with 30% of ZEC locked in shielded pools, and a broader privacy coin rally.
title: Zcash Soars 42% Amid Tightening Supply and Fund Buying

details: Solana (SOL) is attracting significant institutional capital, with $53 million in recent inflows defying broader crypto market outflows. Spot Solana ETFs have seen consistent accumulation, with cumulative flows exceeding $1 billion since October 2025. This institutional confidence is contributing to lower volatility and positions SOL for potential further upside.
title: Solana Sees Strong Institutional Inflows, Volatility Low

details: Andreessen Horowitz's crypto arm (a16z crypto) has closed its fifth dedicated crypto fund at $2.2 billion. This fund aims to support startups that are transforming new infrastructure into everyday products, signaling renewed institutional confidence in crypto infrastructure despite a broader contraction in venture capital funding for the sector.
title: a16z Crypto Raises $2.2 Billion for Fifth Dedicated Fund
